formal_statement: ¬ (∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 4 → ℂ), Module.finrank ℂ L = 3 ∧ (∀ t ∈ L, ∀ i j : Fin 4, t (i, j) = t (j, i)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ L, Matrix.permanent (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin 4) => (1 : ℂ) + t (i, j)) = 24)
plain_statement: The negation, wrapped whole, of the statement that some 3-dimensional linear space L of symmetric 4 x 4 complex matrices keeps the permanent of the matrix with entries 1 + t(i, j) equal to 24 for every t in L. Equivalent to: every such symmetric space has dimension at most 2. Conjecture.
title: Probe: no three-dimensional space of 4 x 4 complex symmetric matrices keeps the permanent of the all-ones matrix plus it at 24
